t: The Best Vintage Home Decor to Buy, According to Design Experts | Architectural Digest
s: October 10, 2017 - “It’s like searching for a treasure, and there’s no better feeling than finding a really great score,” says thrifting and interiors expert ​​Katie Zamprioli of Candy Colored Home. Decorator Nancy Cavaliere, the self-described Secondhand Sorceress of New York City, agrees. Her vintage steals and deals have become a valuable collection. “Basically, my stocks and bonds are in chintz, crystal, Limoges, and Scalamandré upholstered sofas,” she says. Clearly there’s a why to shop vintage. As for what to buy, here the vintage-obsessed walk us through their favorite pieces to hunt for at flea markets, antique shops, estate sales, and anywhere else you might dig up decorative gold.
